other_conditions: Applicant must be a daughter of a poor individual belonging to Other Backward Classes (excluding minorities within backward classes)
Maximum of two daughters per family are eligible for the grant
Priority is given to destitute women who are widows; they are exempted from providing a caste certificate
Applicants must apply online within 90 days before or after the date of marriage
Eligibility depends on annual income: not exceeding Rs. 56,460 in urban areas or Rs. 46,080 in rural areas
benefits_summary: Provides a marriage grant of ₹20,000 per marriage.
